description_en: Adds cards to a specified group
name: AddCardToDirectionalGroup

parameters.help_en: The collection of ICCID values for the cards. The maximum number of ICCIDs is 200
parameters.help_zh: 卡号的iccid集合，数量小于等于200
parameters.name: iccid_list

parameters.help_en:
The method used to add cards. Valid values:

NEW: imports only the cards that are not assigned to any group.

TRANSFER: imports all cards. The cards are removed from their original groups
parameters.help_zh:
添加的方式：

NEW：仅导入其中待分组的卡

TRANSFER：全量导入（卡从原分组中删除）
parameters.name: add_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to push a notification through MQ after successful execution. Default value: false. Valid values: 

false: does not push a notification. 

true: pushes a notification
parameters.help_zh:
执行成功后是否通过MQ推送，默认false： 

false：不推送 

true： 推送
parameters.name: msg_notify

Code.description_en:
The return code. Valid values:

200: The call was successful.

Other values: The call failed. For more information, see error codes
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

200：调用成功。

其他：调用失败。错误码详情，请参见错误码

Result.description_en:
Indicates whether the execution was successful. Valid values:

true: The cards were added successfully.

false: The cards failed to be added
Result.description_zh:
执行是否成功。

true：添加成功。

false：添加失败

SerialNo.description_en: The request number. The idempotence sequence number

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

LocalizedMessage.description_en: The error message displayed in the language corresponding to the current location
LocalizedMessage.description_zh: 根据当前所在地展示对应语言的错误提示

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. The identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。 false：调用失败
